chars.WIFE: WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her early 30s wearing a mustard-yellow hijab and a long emerald-green kaftan dress with gold trim
chars.NEIGHBOUR: NEIGHBOUR: a handsome young Moroccan man of 27 with neatly styled short black hair and light stubble, wearing a white linen shirt with rolled sleeves and beige chinos
chars.HUSBAND: HUSBAND: a Moroccan man of 38 with a short beard and black rectangular glasses, wearing a burgundy polo shirt and dark jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At a family celebration party in a Moroccan apartment living room with low sedari sofas and mint tea trays, WIFE, beaming and laughing, greets NEIGHBOUR warmly at the open front door; he holds a gift box. Seen from inside the room, head-to-waist, both faces visible, guests blurred in the background.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A sunny Moroccan residential street with white apartment buildings; NEIGHBOUR carries cardboard moving boxes into the building next door, smiling, a small moving van behind him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: On the building staircase, HUSBAND stops and looks with a surprised, slightly comic raised eyebrow at NEIGHBOUR, who smiles confidently and adjusts his shirt collar; warm afternoon light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: WIFE, smiling, carries a steaming clay tagine on a tray out of a Moroccan kitchen with blue zellige tiles, heading toward the neighbour's door across the landing.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Dinner in a cozy Moroccan dining room: HUSBAND, WIFE and NEIGHBOUR sit around a round table with tagine and bread, NEIGHBOUR telling a story, HUSBAND laughing, WIFE listening closely.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the living room, WIFE and NEIGHBOUR sit on a sofa holding open novels, comparing pages and smiling excitedly at each other, a bookshelf behind them.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Evening: WIFE and NEIGHBOUR talk animatedly on the shared building balcony with tea glasses, while in the background through the window HUSBAND sits alone on the sofa watching TV.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND, relaxed and naive, sips mint tea on the sofa with a calm content smile, looking toward the balcony door, head-to-waist, soft lamp light.
